description: The GA Message the live API returns carries `diagnostics: null` (observed 2026-10-05 against api.anthropic.com, POST /v1/messages, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001), but the spec models `diagnostics` only on BetaMessage. Strict response validation rejects keys a schema does not model, so a real reply failed it. Model the member on Message as BetaMessage does: optional, nullable.

value.description: Request-level diagnostics. `null` when no prompt-cache divergence was detected.
